info.title: CodedDevs Content API
info.description: Implemented public content reads and authenticated Admin content, article, settings, and revalidation-job operations.

get.summary: Read the published public site content

200.description: Published article summaries and pagination metadata.

get.summary: Read a published article by slug

200.description: Draft and published homepage section states.
Published all section drafts. Response is { success: true, count }.
Collection records with draft and published snapshots.
Saved draft without changing the published snapshot.
Admin article records containing draft and published snapshots.

201.description: Created draft, or published immediately when requested.

200.description: Updated draft; a published snapshot remains unchanged until publish.
Private preview of the draft snapshot.
Committed publication and queued cache revalidation. A failed revalidation does not roll back publication.
Paginated revalidation job statuses; internal response bodies and credentials are not included.
Claimed job and completed an attempt.

AdminSession.name: __Host-codeddevs-admin-session
AdminSession.description: Production cookie. Development and test use codeddevs-admin-session without Secure; both are HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict. State-changing Admin calls also require the configured exact Origin and X-CodedDevs-CSRF: 1.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly equal the configured Admin origin.

SettingsDraft.description: A non-empty subset of SiteSettings fields; the merged result must satisfy SiteSettings.

Forbidden.description: Origin, CSRF, or authorization policy rejected the request.

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid query/body; response is { error: "Invalid request" }.

ContentNotFound.description: Content not found; unpublished public articles also return this response.

ContentConflict.description: Content conflicts with an existing record, such as a duplicate article slug.

ContentUnavailable.description: Content persistence unavailable; response does not expose internal details.

InternalError.description: Internal server error; details are not returned.
